name: sge-gestion-empleados
description: Sistema de Gestión de Empleados - Vue 3 + NestJS + PostgreSQL + JWT

scripts.dev: npm run db:asegurar && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run api" "npm run web"
scripts.instalar: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:crear: /Library/PostgreSQL/18/bin/initdb -D .pgdata -U postgres --auth=trust -E UTF8 --locale=C && npm run db:iniciar && /Library/PostgreSQL/18/bin/psql -h localhost -p 5433 -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE sge_empleados;'
